intro: Tharnariun Treetender is a night elf naturalist stationed in the coastal settlement of Auberdine in Darkshore. Dedicated to safeguarding the delicate balance of the wild, he monitors the creeping corruption afflicting the regional flora and fauna. Travelers passing through the port often find him calling upon allies to heal diseased beasts and protect nature from further decline.

p: Perched on the rugged coast of Darkshore, the port town of Auberdine faces threats on multiple fronts, from hostile satyrs to foul shoreline washaways. Tharnariun Treetender focuses his efforts squarely on the natural world that surrounds the village. Firmly believing that neglecting nature invites ruin, he spends his time observing the decline of the local woods and seeking ways to push back the sickness spreading across the forest floor.
